# Official style provenance

Verified 2026-09-20 against https://mlsys.org/Conferences/2027/CallForResearchPapers .
Download: https://media.mlsys.org/Conferences/MLSYS2025/mlsys2025style.zip .
The 2027 CFP explicitly reuses the 2025 style. The ZIP and every extracted file are untouched; SHA256SUMS records both. Build uses mlsys2025.sty and mlsys2025.bst directly from this directory. Sample author data and old build metadata in the untouched vendor archive are NOT manuscript content and are never included in the review PDF.

Verified constraints: anonymous research-track review; two columns; at most 10 main pages excluding references; separate appendix; full author lists in references. The CFP controls where its appendix policy differs from the older example. No margins, font sizes, spacing, column geometry or style internals have been changed. The default review notice is retained. PDF subject metadata is set to MLSys 2027 in manuscript content.
